purpose: Define explicit handling for scheduled occurrences missed while runtime/service is unavailable, preventing silent replay storms or loss.

topics.name: Missed Occurrence and Catch-up
topics.purpose: Define explicit handling for scheduled occurrences missed while runtime/service is unavailable, preventing silent replay storms or loss.

semantics.policy_rule: Each recurring schedule/profile declares or inherits an explicit missed-occurrence policy.
semantics.history_rule: Missed occurrence identities/times remain traceable according to retention policy.
semantics.bounded_rule: Replay/catch-up is finitely bounded by count/time-window/rate limits.
semantics.dedupe_rule: Previously emitted/completed occurrences are not replayed merely because runtime restarted.
semantics.ordering_rule: Catch-up ordering is explicit where multiple occurrences are replayed.
semantics.failure_rule: Excess backlog beyond policy is surfaced explicitly.
semantics.authority_rule: Catch-up does not bypass current authorization/assurance at downstream dispatch time.
semantics.clock_rule: Clock jumps/restarts do not silently synthesize arbitrary occurrence history.

invariants.rule: A schedule determines when a scheduling occurrence may be emitted; it never directly executes a Routine, command or operation. Execution requires the normal explicit Event→Trigger→Runner/operation causality chain.

hard_gates.condition: missed runs silently discarded without policy

references.purpose: Missed-run policy is scoped to exact schedules.

prose.summary: Define explicit handling for scheduled occurrences missed while runtime/service is unavailable, preventing silent replay storms or loss.
